summary: Weekly operations sync at Atlas Agency. Decisions: contract template v3 is now mandatory for every new client, and no-meeting Fridays start this week. Timesheets have been blocked for two weeks because half the team can't log in to Harvest since the switch to Google SSO. The junior account manager job ad needs to go live this week.
